d) 
$$ Let \  \sigma_{LH} = \text{standard deviation of the number of hands raised among students with low absenteeism} \\
Let \ \sigma_{HH} = \text{standard deviation of the number of hands raised among students with high absenteeism}
$$
$$ H_0: \sigma_{LH} = \sigma_{HH}$$
$$ H_A: \sigma_{LH} \ne \sigma_{HH}$$
$$ \text{We will be using a significance level of} \  \alpha = 0.05$$

$$ \text{We are going to perform a 2 sample t-test, more specifically Levene's test of equal variance. The test is essentially a 2 sample t test of the absolute difference \\ from the median. We require 3 assumptions to be satisfied in order for this test to be administered. }$$
$$  
1. \text{Independence: We are assuming independence as there is no verifiable way to prove if the data is dependent or independent as there are no identifying columns.} \\
2. \text{Representative sample: The sample will be assumed to be representative of the target population of all Kalboard 360 students.} \\
3. \text{Normality: The sample size is sufficiently large n = 480 so we can utilize the central limit theorem and assume the sample mean is approximately normal.}
$$


```{r}
xAPI_Edu_Data = read.csv("dataset/xAPI-Edu-Data.csv")
high_absent_hands <- xAPI_Edu_Data$raisedhands[xAPI_Edu_Data$StudentAbsenceDays == "Above-7"]

low_absent_hands <- xAPI_Edu_Data$raisedhands[xAPI_Edu_Data$StudentAbsenceDays == "Under-7"]

head(high_absent_hands,4)
head(low_absent_hands,4)

favstats(high_absent_hands)
favstats(low_absent_hands)

leveneTest(raisedhands ~ StudentAbsenceDays, data = xAPI_Edu_Data, conf.level = 0.95)
```

```{r}
ggplot(xAPI_Edu_Data,aes(x = StudentAbsenceDays, y = raisedhands, fill = StudentAbsenceDays)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.colour = "red", outlier.shape = 16) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 4, color = "black") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Above-7" = "#E41A1C", "Under-7" = "#377EB8")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Raised Hands by Student Absence Days",
    x = "Student Absence Days",
    y = "Number of Raised Hands",
    caption = "Black diamonds represent the mean values"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") # Removes redundant legend
```

At a 0.05 significance level, our p-value from our Levene's t test is 0.09431. The p-value is higher than our significance level. With 95% confidence, we fail to reject the null hypothesis. The standard devations of hands raised in the low and high absenteeism students are the same.
